496:t_1:89.en:
$$ミコット$$
「See you, $$バナージ$$. I'll leave the rest to you.」

496:t_1:91.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Is this okay, $$オードリー$$...? Coming to a place like the hangar...」

496:t_1:94.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「You still call me $$オードリー$$, even now.」

496:t_1:96.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「It's all right. ...At least for now...」

496:t_1:98.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「When I'm here, I'm not the Princess of $$ジオン$$. I'm a member of $c.」

496:t_1:99.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But we can't go on like this...」

496:t_1:100.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Yes... To free the colonies taken in by the $$サイデリアル$$, I have to fulfill my duty.」

496:t_1:101.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I believe your $$ユニコーン$$ will lend its strength to that, too.」

496:t_1:103.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$バナージ$$... Traveling with $c, I've seen so many things.」

496:t_1:104.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I had the knowledge, but I realized you only truly know something once you see it, hear it, feel it, and experience it. I realized I never knew the world until now...」

496:t_1:105.en:
$$バナージ$$
「It's the same for me. The fighting drove it home.」

496:t_1:106.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Even when people get to know each other, they can't join hands that easily. Being unable to break free of our births and our ties is part of being human.」

496:t_1:107.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Space and Earth... Even if $$クロノ$$ intended that, people have fought, each from their own position...」

496:t_1:108.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But that man... $$カーディアス・ビスト$$... still wished for the $$ラプラスの箱$$ to be opened. Believing there is a future beyond it.」

496:t_1:109.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I want to believe too. In people's goodwill.」

496:t_1:111.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$バナージ$$... Thank you for protecting the $$ユニコーン$$... the key to $$ラプラスの箱$$... all the way to today.」

496:t_1:112.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$シャア$$ and I both intend to leave the opening of the Box to you.」

496:t_1:114.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I don't know why $$フル・フロンタル$$ seeks the Box in this world now...」

496:t_1:115.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Even if we got the Box before him, we wouldn't know what it means, either.」

496:t_1:117.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Let me say the rest, $$オードリー$$.」

496:t_1:119.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I don't know what the Box is, either... Even when they say it has the power to overturn the $$地球連邦$$, honestly, I can't even imagine it...」

496:t_1:120.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...For a while, I intended to seal away the Box, which breeds conflict, so that no one could touch it.」

496:t_1:121.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But I came to think that's the same as running away.」

496:t_1:123.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So I... once we free Earth from the $$サイデリアル$$, I plan to open the $$ラプラスの箱$$.」

496:t_1:124.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Whatever it turns out to be, I want to face it and think properly about what to do...」

496:t_1:125.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I feel that's what I owe my father, Lieutenant Colonel $$ダグザ$$, the people of $$ジオン$$... everyone who died over the Box.」

496:t_1:126.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I understand, $$バナージ$$. I respect your thinking.」

496:t_1:128.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Until that day comes, I'm counting on you to look after the $$ユニコーン$$.」

496:t_1:133.en: ～ $$ラー・カイラム$$ $$アムロ・レイ$$'s Quarters ～

496:t_1:134.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...That's rare. You, visiting my room.」

496:t_1:135.en:
$$シャア$$
「I'm not exactly someone with a place in this unit.」

496:t_1:136.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Self-deprecation gets irritating when it goes too far.」

496:t_1:137.en:
$$シャア$$
「To reflect on myself, blunt words like that are a help.」

496:t_1:140.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...I hear $$バナージ$$ told $$ミネバ$$ he intends to open the Box.」

496:t_1:141.en:
$$シャア$$
「I heard it from $$ミネバ$$.」

496:t_1:142.en:
$$アムロ$$
「What do you think about the $$ラプラスの箱$$?」

496:t_1:143.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$フロンタル$$ was chasing it on his own initiative. I took $$クロノ$$ as my target, but I never paid attention to any connection there.」

496:t_1:144.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But with $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$ and $$ヴェーダ$$ both keeping silent now, that's the only key left to finding out what $$クロノ$$ really is.」

496:t_1:145.en:
$$シャア$$
「On top of that, I'm curious why $$フロンタル$$ is so fixated on the Box.」

496:t_1:146.en:
$$シャア$$
「During the $$時獄戦役$$... I thought his true nature was my body double with my consciousness from a parallel world flowing into it.」

496:t_1:148.en:
$$シャア$$
「That's exactly why I could understand part of what he's thinking. But...」

496:t_1:149.en:
$$アムロ$$
「And now you can't do that... is that it?」

496:t_1:150.en:
$$シャア$$
「If he is another possibility of me, I want to know his true intent.」

496:t_1:154.en:
$$シャア$$
「Has the position of the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ been discovered...!?」

496:t_1:155.en:
$$フェルト$$
「To all members of $c. A unit thought to be $$ネオ・ジオン$$ is approaching this area.」

496:t_1:156.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Mobile unit members, prepare to sortie immediately.」

496:t_1:157.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ネオ・ジオン$$ is coming...!」

496:t_2:3.en: ～ $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ Deep-Space Mothership - Dock ～

496:t_2:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But he didn't betray us.」

496:t_2:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Depending on how things go, $$フロンタル$$ may have $$シャア$$ executed and use him as a tool to incite the Spacenoids.」

496:t_2:11.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Then why did Colonel $$シャア$$...!?」

496:t_2:12.en:
$$アムロ$$
「He means to settle things with his own shadow in his own way.」

496:t_2:13.en:
$$アムロ$$
「To do that, he staked everything on the pride inside $$フロンタル$$.」

496:t_2:14.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You mean that man will choose to face the Colonel...?」
